shortTitle: Definitions for care cascades in Diabetes Care
longTitle: Comparing approaches for deriving diabetes care cascades to inform policy: a cross-sectional analysis using national data from 88 countries
summary:
Felix led the analysis of representative surveys from 88 countries to study if different approaches to defining care cascades have consistent policy implications.

The paper was accepted for publication in Diabetes Care, the journal of the American Diabetes Association
citation: Teufel F., HPACC Collaborators, Ali M.K., Varghese J.S. Comparing approaches for deriving diabetes care cascades to inform policy: a cross-sectional analysis using national data from 88 countries. Diabetes Care. 2026.
